Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on landing or repair-ledger.

ui_bugs.issue: Source JSX uses inert="" (empty string). React 18+/19 strips empty-string boolean attributes at render time — DOM elements with [data-marquee-clone] end up WITHOUT the inert attribute at runtime (getAttribute('inert') returns null on all 10 clones; React logs 'Received an empty string for a boolean attribute inert' warning). Functionally a11y is preserved (Tab never focuses clone contents thanks to aria-hidden+role=presentation), but P2-4 spec requirement 'every [data-marquee-clone] has the inert attribute' fails. Fix: use inert={true} (React 19 supports it) or set el.inert = true via ref/useEffect for older React.

rca_of_the_issue: P1-1 edge-probe bug: /api/public/edge-probe used `raise HTTPException(...)` for the token check but server.py imported only `FastAPI, APIRouter, Request, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect` from fastapi. NameError bubbled to a 500. Unit acceptance tests in iter-204 exercised the trust_stats module directly (never routed through the endpoint) so the regression slipped through. Repro: `curl -X POST $BACKEND/api/public/edge-probe -d '{}' -H 'content-type:application/json'` → 500 pre-fix / 401 post-fix. Mitigation applied: added HTTPException to the from-fastapi import list at server.py:12.
